03. Regression, smoke and sanity testing

Regression testing detects broken existing behavior; smoke testing broadly checks critical paths;
sanity testing is usually a focused check after a change.
Smoke test එJකන් build එJක් වැදගත් features ටික බලනවා. Sanity test එJකන් Jවනස් කළ
Jකාටස බලනවා. Regression test එJකන් පරණ features කැඩිලාද බලනවා.
After fixing checkout, check login and cart quickly, verify the fix, then run the regression suite.

Sanity test එJකන් Jවනස් කළ Jකාටස බලනවා. · Regression test එJකන් පරණ features කැඩිලාද බලනවා.
Expected result: A build can pass smoke but fail regression; terminology varies by team.

Q: Are smoke and sanity the same?
A: Not necessarily; smoke is broad and shallow, sanity usually narrow and focused.
